title: Contracts
summary: Contracts (May Subd Geog) is the heading for general works on contracts. Specific types of contracts, including construction and engineering contracts, are established as uninverted phrase headings (e.g. Artists' contracts, Shipbuilding contracts). The free-floating subdivision --Contracts and specifications was discontinued in 1989.
validation_rules: The subdivision `--Contracts and specifications` (formerly under construction and engineering headings) was discontinued in 1989 and is invalid. (H 1468 Background)
General works on contracts: `Contracts` (May Subd Geog). (H 1468 sec. 1)

Specific types of contracts, including construction and engineering contracts, are phrase headings in straight (uninverted) form, e.g. `Artists' contracts`, `Mechanical engineering contracts`, `Research and development contracts`, `Shipbuilding contracts` (not `Contracts, Artists'`). (H 1468 sec. 2)

sections.heading: 1. Contracts in general
sections.text: Assign the heading *Contracts (May Subd Geog)* to general works about contracts.

sections.heading: 2. Special types of contracts
sections.text:
Establish phrase headings for works containing or discussing specific types of contracts, including those pertaining to types of construction or engineering. Establish these headings in straight rather than inverted form. Examples:

```
150 ## $a Artists' contracts
150 ## $a Mechanical engineering contracts
150 ## $a Research and development contracts
150 ## $a Shipbuilding contracts
```
